findings.title: Mule Funnel (Transfer to Cash): Rohan Verma received ₹495,000 and withdrew ₹250,000 cash
findings.whatHappened: Rohan Verma received an inbound transfer of ₹495,000.00 on Bank Account 501200778814, quickly distributed ₹1,050,000.00 across 4 separate accounts, and liquidated ₹250,000.00 in cash through 2 ATM withdrawals within 30 minutes.
findings.whyUnusual: Retail accounts retain balances for standard living expenses over days or weeks. Immediately passing funds from an inbound wire directly into multi-party split transfers and physical cash liquidation is a high-confidence indicator of money laundering.
findings.whyRelevant: Directly impacts case objectives by exposing Cash-Out Mule Node in the syndicate hierarchy. Activity spans 4 distinct case domains (SOCIAL, BANKING, CROSS_DOMAIN, NETWORK). Entity occupies a central cut-out broker role connecting syndicate cells in case graph.
supportingObservations: Corroborated by 34 verified canonical event(s) across 4 domain(s)
reasons: Corroborated by 34 verified canonical event(s) across 4 domain(s)
